name: This website
highlight: You're driving through it right now.
brief: My personal site as a little driving game: pick a world, scroll, and the jeep drives you through my life.
story: I didn't want a boring portfolio. So every part of my life got its own map, from trekking trails to this neon city.
learned: Scroll-driven animation is 10% maths and 90% tweaking numbers.
